School y: I have priority 1. In the worst case, I get y.
School z: I have priority 2. It's possible someone else with priority 1 gets z, and I don't get z.

So, the worst-case set of schools I could be matched with is {w, y}. Since my preference is z > x > w > y, I want to rank z and x as high as possible to try and get them.

Therefore, my ranking should be z > x > w > y.
